briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents in Minneapolis has sparked widespread outrage and calls for investigation. The incident has raised concerns about police brutality and the use of force by law enforcement. According to sources, including The New York Times and Fox News, the FBI has launched an investigation into the shooting. I have identified a pattern of incidents involving federal agents using force in questionable circumstances, and further investigation is needed to determine the circumstances surrounding the shooting and whether the use of force was justified. The Minneapolis Police Department and federal agents are entities of interest in this investigation. Next steps include tracking the progress of the FBI investigation and monitoring for any developments in the case. Sources: The New York Times, Fox News, https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/25/us/minneapolis-shooting.html, https://www.foxnews.com/politics/fbi-director-patel-speaks-on-investigation-into-cbp-involved-shooting-in-minneapolis.
